description: This file defines API functions for managing defect reports, including listing, retrieving, creating defects, uploading images, and downloading PDFs. It also contains mock data for fallback scenarios.

methods.name: listDefects
methods.description: Lists defects from backend; falls back to mock data if endpoint unavailable.

methods.name: getDefect
methods.description: Retrieves a defect by its ID, with fallback to mock data if not found.

methods.name: createDefect
methods.description: Creates a new defect, adding it to mock data if backend is unavailable.

methods.name: uploadDefectImage
methods.description: Uploads an image for a defect; falls back to object URL storage in mock mode.

methods.name: downloadDefectPdf
methods.description: Downloads a PDF report for a defect, returning a Blob.
